notice: This map describes connected software and operating concepts. It does not represent active government funding, legal tender, banking, benefits, hotel inventory, metal redemption, healthcare, housing, cryptocurrency, securities, Avatar Coin value, or guaranteed products.

modules.name: Infinity AI Token Studio
modules.purpose: Applies one subtle universal Star mark to convertible objects, ranks the products Infinity needs most, creates named Star Blueprint versions, calculates Product Token supply and Avatar Coin identity requirements, and wires verified results into Store Cards, Wallet, Coin Planner, fulfillment, and clearing.

modules.name: Good Bee Living
modules.purpose: Voluntary vacations, trial stays, supported moves, accessible housing, nursing coordination, transportation, return planning, and robot-assisted construction.

modules.name: Infinity Store Cards
modules.purpose: Physical and digital cards, NFC/RFID access, merchant offers, drops, auctions, relic cards, receipts, returns, warranties, ownership, and provenance.

modules.name: Reciprocal Clearing
modules.purpose: Converts eligible Store Claims into general Infinity units only after the source claim is locked and permanently retired.

modules.name: Infinity AI Wallet
modules.purpose: Turns a complex graph of Star Blueprints, Product Tokens, Avatar Coins, units, claims, products, hotels, metals, discounts, work, ads, rights, and approvals into understandable choices.

modules.name: Infinity Coin Planner
modules.purpose: Discovers and verifies businesses, negotiates local and bulk capacity, predicts destination demand, stages products, closes funding gaps, and assembles packages.

modules.name: Alien Radio Star and Avatar System
modules.purpose: Uses the working Alien Radio platform as the first connected example: universal Star marks create station versions and Product Token plans; another verified user's 24 continuous qualified hours produce one Avatar Coin; one Avatar Coin locks to one active radio-station identity.

modules.name: New Hope Program Layer
modules.purpose: Uses voluntary, appealable AI assistance to match people with destinations, support, necessities, training, work, business tools, and funded daily participation support.

modules.name: Infinity Robotic Housing
modules.purpose: Creates accessible, repairable, modular homes using standardized components, robot-assisted production, licensed review, permits, inspections, and component records.

modules.name: Infinity Business Coins
modules.purpose: Stores a living business plan, storefront, products, capacity, advertising budget, contribution history, milestones, rights, Avatar identity where required, and linked growth branches.

modules.name: Physical Metal Access
modules.purpose: Separates general digital Infinity units from limited, audited weekly access to specifically described silver or gold products.

modules.name: AI Livelihood Engine
modules.purpose: Finds useful paid work from interests, abilities, local need, business capacity, research, reviewing, building, care, production, and accepted AI-assisted contributions.

valueTypes.name: Star Blueprint
valueTypes.meaning: A named, attributable, versioned and reversible creation record opened by the universal small Star mark.

valueTypes.name: Product Token
valueTypes.meaning: The exact product, service, capacity, component, identity system, or work deliverable Infinity needs produced.

valueTypes.name: Avatar Coin
valueTypes.meaning: An identity-activation record produced under a verified-use rule and locked to one active operating identity.

valueTypes.name: Program Funding
valueTypes.meaning: Actual external money, grants, contracts, donations, customer payments, or other received resources.

valueTypes.name: Store Claim
valueTypes.meaning: A specific promise for a product, service, destination, benefit, capacity, or merchant value.

valueTypes.name: Infinity Unit
valueTypes.meaning: A general internal transfer and accounting unit issued under the clearing and treasury rules.

valueTypes.name: Metal Access
valueTypes.meaning: A limited eligibility to receive a specifically described physical silver or gold product.

valueTypes.name: Ownership Record
valueTypes.meaning: Evidence about a physical card, relic, object, digital record, custody, rights, and transfer history.

valueTypes.name: Contribution Record
valueTypes.meaning: A reviewable record of accepted human and AI-assisted work, rights, approval, and compensation.

valueTypes.name: Sponsored Engagement
valueTypes.meaning: A funded advertising or promotional reward with budget, anti-fraud controls, and measurable event.

coreRules: The universal small Star mark means create, edit, version, convert, connect, or inspect ancestry; it does not mean favorite, endorsement, verification, or guaranteed value.
A Product Token is a typed production plan and cannot become a Store Claim until provider, capacity, funding, restrictions, fulfillment, refund, and rights evidence are verified.
A production Avatar Coin cannot be created by creator self-use, bots, hidden or idle pages, or clearly labeled demonstration time.
One Avatar Coin locks to one active operating identity when that identity type requires an Avatar Coin.
A specific Store Claim and its replacement Infinity units cannot remain spendable at the same time.
No package publishes while its actual contracted cost has an unfunded gap.
A public business listing does not enroll a merchant or authorize payment.
The person controls destination, support, conversion, travel, work, creation versions, and irreversible approvals.
AI may discover, compare, calculate, organize, monitor, and explain but cannot secretly redirect money, fabricate capacity or use, or approve its own transaction.
Physical metal inventory, hotel nights, products, support hours, work roles, station identities, and business capacity are verified before claims are issued.
Health, identity, ownership, financial, travel, support, activity, and merchant payout information remain outside public GitHub repositories.
Corrections and new Star versions append events instead of silently rewriting history.
